segments.text:
V. 4.
John had his raiment of camels' hair—Coarſe and rough, ſuiting his Character and Doctrine. A leathern girdle—Like El•jah, in whoſe Spirit and Power he came. His food was locuſts and wild honey— Locuſts are ranked among clean Meats, Lev. xi. 22. But theſe were not always to be had. So in Default of thoſe, he fed on wild Honey.
